about.title: About
about.subtitle: A personal project built by a climber, for climbers.

story.title: The Story
story.content: Crimp Studio started as a learning project around Three.js, procedural generation, and computer vision. It grew into two pillars: a studio where you design walls and problems with real hold shapes, and a scanner that will read real walls from photos. No expensive hardware, no LED boards.

studio.title: Studio
studio.description: Design walls in 3D with hold models from real 3D-printable packs, place problems by hand, and soon generate them procedurally with a difficulty estimate you can interrogate.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Point a camera at a real wall, get its problems back, and watch an animated climber show a possible beta. In the lab.
